tagline: A leafy, upscale suburb in the Belgrade Forest belt on Istanbul's northern European edge — gated communities, equestrian clubs, and a village-within-nature feel that few Istanbullus even know exists.

items.name: Belgrad Ormanı
items.description: One of Istanbul's oldest and most beautiful urban forests — ancient water reservoirs, dense woodland, and excellent walking and cycling trails.
items.tip: Enter from the Göktürk side to avoid the busier Bahçeköy entrance. Peaceful and uncrowded on weekdays.

items.name: Ata Spor Binicilik Kulübü
items.description: One of several equestrian clubs in the Göktürk area offering horse riding lessons and trail rides through the forest.

items.name: Göktürk Köy Kafeleri
items.description: Relaxed café terraces in the village centre and along the forest roads — excellent for a slow weekend brunch after a morning hike.

items.name: Köy Restoranları
items.description: A handful of village restaurants serving classic Turkish meze and grills. Unhurried and perfect for long weekend lunches.

tips: Göktürk is best reached by car — public transport is very limited from the city centre.
The Belgrade Forest is one of the best day trips from Istanbul; combine with a Göktürk café stop.
Rents are high by Istanbul standards — this is premium suburban living.
Very quiet during the week; village cafés fill up with families on Sundays.
